0.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_000010_MINFILIA
0.description: We have a guest from Ishgard who wishes to speak with you.

1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_000020_MINFILIA
1.description: I believe the two of you have met?

2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_000030_LUCIA
2.description: We have. I had hoped to speak with Commander Leveilleur as well, but I cannot afford to wait any longer.

3.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_000040_LUCIA
3.description: The lord commander sent me hither to request your aid in a matter of grave import.

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_000050_MOENBRYDA
4.description: You see now why I had Tataru summon you.

5.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_000060_MINFILIA
5.description: Now that we are all assembled, perhaps you would be good enough to elaborate on the nature of the matter which brought you to us.

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_000070_LUCIA
6.description: The Observatorium's astrologians have sounded the alarum.

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_000080_LUCIA
7.description: Last night, the dragon star burned with an intensity not seen in fifteen summers.

8.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_000090_LUCIA
8.description: Not since the Dravanians engaged the Empire in the Battle of Silvertear Skies.

9.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_000100_URIANGER
9.description: “The northern sky doth burn full bright upon the wyrm lord's call. The red behemoth beckoneth, and flame consumeth all.”

11.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_000120_LUCIA
11.description: The brightening of the dragon star is said to accompany the roar of a great wyrm. The astrologians believe that it was Midgardsormr himself who cried out on this occasion.

12.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_000130_URIANGER
12.description: After an absence of centuries, the king of kings did return to lead his kind against the might of Garlemald...

13.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_000140_URIANGER
13.description: ...Only to fall in his duel with the <hex:021A020203>Agrius<hex:021A020103>, proud flagship of the Garlean fleet. Devoid of life, his corpse remaineth entwined about the magitek monstrosity even unto this day.

14.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_000150_MINFILIA
14.description: Urianger has the right of it. Whatever this alteration in the dragon star portends, the great wyrm has shown no sign of life.

15.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_000160_MINFILIA
15.description: Tataru, have the Domans reported aught out of the ordinary?

16.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_000170_MOENBRYDA
16.description: Correct me if I'm wrong, but if Midgardsormr had roared, wouldn't we have heard it here in Revenant's Toll?

17.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_000180_LUCIA
17.description: “Roar” is but a figure of speech. Dravanians can communicate in ways beyond our ken.

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_000190_LUCIA
18.description: It is for this very reason that we are forced to look for signs in the heavens. We cannot say with any confidence that a great wyrm roared at all, much less that it was Midgardsormr.

19.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_000200_LUCIA
19.description: Only by directly examining the Keeper of the Lake can we be certain. However, it will take too long to gain the Holy See's approval to dispatch the Temple Knights.

20.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_000210_LUCIA
20.description: Therefore, Ser Aymeric would entrust this task to you. Do you accept?

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_000220_LUCIA
21.description: We knew you would not disappoint us. Now, if you would excuse me, I must return and assist the lord commander. We have precious little time to prepare.

22.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_000230_MINFILIA
22.description: To prepare for what, pray tell?

23.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_000240_LUCIA
23.description: When a great wyrm roars, his brethren cannot choose but answer. We prepare for battle.

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_100010_MIDGARDSORMR
24.description: Who treadeth now upon my bones and waketh me from slumber sweet?

25.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_100020_MIDGARDSORMR
25.description: Thou hast forgotten the face of thy lord. Remember, mortal, and fear me.

26.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_200010_MIDGARDSORMR
26.description: By Her gifts hast thou earned a moment's reprieve.

27.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_200020_MIDGARDSORMR
27.description: Speak, mortal, and I shall listen.

28.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_200030_MIDGARDSORMR
28.description: Guided by a <hex:021A020203>star<hex:021A020103>...? Heh heh heh.

29.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_200040_MIDGARDSORMR
29.description: My people have heard the song. Ishgard shall burn.

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_200050_MIDGARDSORMR
30.description: Sons must answer for their fathers' misdeeds.

31.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_200060_MIDGARDSORMR
31.description: We do not forget. We do not forgive.

32.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_200070_MIDGARDSORMR
32.description: Seven children did I sire. One now singeth of retribution.

33.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_200080_MIDGARDSORMR
33.description: I rise to join in the chorus.

34.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_200090_MIDGARDSORMR
34.description: Thou art powerless to silence us, mortal. Yet thou shalt not live to labor in vain. Thy reprieve is at an end.

35.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_200100_MIDGARDSORMR
35.description: Hmph. Trickery is thy shield. This frail, ignoble creature is not gifted, but chosen...

36.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_200110_MIDGARDSORMR
36.description: Hearken to me, Hydaelyn! I remember...and I <hex:021A020203>consent<hex:021A020103>.

37.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_200120_MIDGARDSORMR
37.description: Fear not, mortal... I shall not harm thee...

38.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_200130_MIDGARDSORMR
38.description: Heh heh heh. Mayhap thou thinkest me an oathbreaker?

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_200140_MIDGARDSORMR
39.description: Thou art mistaken. If thou comest to harm, it shall be by another's hand, not mine.

40.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_200150_MIDGARDSORMR
40.description: I did but strip thee of thy mistress's feeble blessing.

41.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_200160_MIDGARDSORMR
41.description: Thou didst profit much by Her grace, but no more.

42.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_200170_MIDGARDSORMR
42.description: The covenant binds me to thee.

44.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_200190_MIDGARDSORMR
44.description: Fight and struggle, if it be thy will.

45.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_200200_MIDGARDSORMR
45.description: Man hath ever coveted that which lieth beyond his grasp.

46.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_200210_MIDGARDSORMR
46.description: I drink of Her body, and thence doth mine own find new life.

47.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_200220_MIDGARDSORMR
47.description: When it hath grown whole, the loyal and penitent shall rejoice.

48.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_200230_MIDGARDSORMR
48.description: The Dragonsong heraldeth a beginning...and an end.

49.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_300010_LUCIA
49.description: My friend! I can scarce believe it! You confronted the wyrm lord and lived to tell the tale!

50.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_300020_LUCIA
50.description: I give thanks to Halone for your preservation. It is our sole cause for gladness.

51.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_300030_LUCIA
51.description: Your encounter with the Keeper of the Lake served to confirm our fears. A great wyrm has roared, and it makes little difference if it was one of the two in Eorzea or any other...

53.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_300050_ALPHINAUD
53.description: I am told that Ishgard has magical defenses against Dravanian attack, though I am not privy to their exact nature.

54.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_300060_ALPHINAUD
54.description: Will they be enough to repel a massive force?

55.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_300070_LUCIA
55.description: Ishgard has weathered countless assaults over centuries. This will be no different.

56.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_300080_LUCIA
56.description: And now that you have confirmed the threat, none can ignore the lord commander's calls for the wards to be strengthened.

57.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_300090_LUCIA
57.description: I dare not presume to speak for him, but I expect the lord commander would sing your praises.

58.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_300100_LUCIA
58.description: I must away, but we shall meet again soon.

59.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_300110_ALPHINAUD
59.description: Countless assaults weathered...and this will be no different? Why am I not convinced?

60.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_400010_MOENBRYDA
60.description: Now that everything's calmed down a bit─relatively speaking, I mean─I thought it might be a good time to share our progress on the weapon.

61.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_400020_MOENBRYDA
61.description: I believe we're on the verge of a breakthrough.

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_400030_MINFILIA
62.description: Well, don't keep us all in suspense.

63.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_400040_MOENBRYDA
63.description: Just in case anyone's forgotten, let's start by reviewing what we already know. So! An Ascian is an immortal because its soul doesn't return to the aetherial realm when its host is defeated. Instead, it flees to the place that lies between our world and the void.

64.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_400050_MOENBRYDA
64.description: Therefore, the first step to <hex:021A020203>permanently<hex:021A020103> defeating an Ascian is preventing its soul from making this journey. And if you recall, when we last gathered here, I had verified that white auracite has adequate capacity to entrap the beings, albeit only briefly.

65.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_400060_THANCRED
65.description: Which left the small matter of their extermination.

66.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_400070_URIANGER
66.description: Aye. To unmake an Ascian soul, one must needs smite it with a concentrated burst, or “blade,” of purest aether. However, we wanted for both the data and the means to forge such a weapon.

67.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_400080_MOENBRYDA
67.description: Short of experimenting on an actual Ascian, you see, there's no way to gauge how much aether its soul is made of.

68.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_400090_MOENBRYDA
68.description: As such, we don't know what aetheric density our blade needs to have in order for it to work.

69.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_400100_YDA
69.description: So we'll just have to make the densest blade we can, and hope for the best! Though that would require a <hex:021A020203>lot<hex:021A020103> of aether...

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_400110_YDA
70.description: Hang on a minute! Why didn't we think of this before!? White auracite can hold an absolute <hex:021A020203>heap<hex:021A020103> of aether, can't it!?

71.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_400120_PAPALYMO
71.description: Please tell me you're joking. Gods' sakes, Yda! I feel as though I'm reliving the same scene over and over with you! How many times do you need to be told that white auracite cannot store aether for long periods?

72.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_400130_PAPALYMO
72.description: Being intangible matter, aether is given to dispersion; only in its crystallized form is it a stable source of energy. I will test you later on this, so see to it you do not forget.

73.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_400140_YDA
73.description: Ah...r-right, yes... It's all coming back to me...

74.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_400150_THANCRED
74.description: So our hopes rest on good old crystals again, do they? While they are certainly reliable, they leave something to be desired in the area of portability.

75.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_400160_YSHTOLA
75.description: Indeed. I am reminded of the quantity of corrupted crystals required to thwart Leviathan, and the extraordinary lengths to which the Lominsans went to transport them. What if it should prove that a similar quantity was needed to destroy an Ascian soul─or still <hex:021A020203>more<hex:021A020103>...?

76.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_400170_THANCRED
76.description: I do not envy the poor sod who has to lug all of that around on the off chance that an Ascian appears.

77.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_400180_MOENBRYDA
77.description: That's the very problem we set out to solve, and I reckon we've found the answer. If it isn't practical to lug around the aether we need, we'll just have to draw upon another source.

78.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_400190_MOENBRYDA
78.description: And the only viable source is the land.

79.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_400200_YSHTOLA
79.description: If you mean to tap the great river of aether, know that it will entail considerable risk. Meddling with the currents may well induce a surge like to the one which despoiled Mor Dhona.

80.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_400210_MOENBRYDA
80.description: Give me a bit more credit, will you? Why would we need to tap the river when there're veritable <hex:021A020203>reservoirs<hex:021A020103> jutting out all over the land?

81.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_400220_MOENBRYDA
81.description: Aye, I speak of corrupted crystals. It might be that their aspect is out of balance, but a crystal's a crystal─it contains aether, and we can help ourselves to it.

82.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_400230_THANCRED
82.description: While corrupted crystals are indeed abundant, there is no guarantee that they will be in close proximity at a crucial moment.

83.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_400240_MOENBRYDA
83.description: Ah, but what if we don't need them to be? What if we could tap their power from <hex:021A020203>afar<hex:021A020103>? A malm away, say?

84.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_400250_MOENBRYDA
84.description: If we could do that, we'd have ready access to aether aplenty in almost every corner of Eorzea.

85.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_400260_MOENBRYDA
85.description: I've yet to put my theories to the proof, but I've got a good feeling about this. If no one has any objections, I'd like to see where this avenue leads.

86.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_400270_MINFILIA
86.description: If you think it worth your while, you have my blessing.

87.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_400280_MINFILIA
87.description: But tell us, what <hex:021A020203>are<hex:021A020103> your theories? I for one am most eager to understand the process, however vaguely.

88.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_400290_MOENBRYDA
88.description: I thought you might say that. But no one wants to listen to boring old theories all day, do they? I know I don't. So, with your permission, I'd like to try something a bit more hands-on. I've already built an aetheric siphon especially for this purpose, and I've been meaning to try it out.

89.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_400300_MOENBRYDA
89.description: Thing is, the profusion of corrupted crystals in Mor Dhona makes it something of a high-risk testing ground. If anything goes awry with the siphon, it would be better if it didn't happen within spitting distance of quite so much aether.

90.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_400310_MOENBRYDA
90.description: Ideally, I need an isolated specimen. Does anyone know where I can find one?

91.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_400320_ALPHINAUD
91.description: May I suggest northern Thanalan? There you will find corrupted crystals of middling size, standing a reasonable distance apart. Ideal for your needs, I should have thought. Oh, and if you do elect to visit the place, I should be much obliged if you would assist me in another matter while you are in the area.

93.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_400340_ALPHINAUD
93.description: Movement has been observed at Castrum Meridianum.

94.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_400350_ALPHINAUD
94.description: During Operation Archon, the Alliance dealt the stronghold a heavy blow. Its facilities were extensively damaged, and its garrison reduced to a fraction of its former strength.

95.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_400360_ALPHINAUD
95.description: Not long after our forces withdrew, however, their ranks were replenished by reinforcements from Castrum Centri. They now seek to rebuild, and to this end they have their sights set upon the Ceruleum Processing Plant.

96.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_400370_ALPHINAUD
96.description: Having lost the Empire's support, the XIVth Legion lacks the resources to sustain itself. To them, this is a bid for survival, and they will doubtless fight like desperate men.

97.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_400380_ALPHINAUD
97.description: Though I have dispatched the Crystal Braves, I fear their strength alone may not suffice to stay the imperial assault. I would request the Scions' aid in the defensive effort.

98.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_400390_MOENBRYDA
98.description: If I didn't know better, I'd say you were trying to inveigle us into fighting your battle with the promise of shiny crystals!

99.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_400400_MOENBRYDA
99.description: Well then, consider me inveigled! I won't lie, the crystals you speak of sound perfect─so the Garleans have to go!

100.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_400410_MOENBRYDA
100.description: Besides, we can't afford to beat about the bush. There's no telling when the Ascians will next appear.

101.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_400420_URIANGER
101.description: Thine eagerness to hurl thyself into the jaws of danger cometh as little surprise. Exercise due caution, I prithee.

102.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_400430_MINFILIA
102.description: Though you have become a Crystal Brave, you are yet a Scion, Alphinaud. We could hardly refuse you.

103.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_400440_MINFILIA
103.description: Pray join the Crystal Braves and lend them your support. Thancred and Papalymo shall accompany you.

104.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_400450_MINFILIA
104.description: Yda and Y'shtola─in the meantime I would have you assist Moenbryda. Scout out the crystal clusters, that the testing may commence as soon as the Garlean threat has been eliminated.

105.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_400460_URIANGER
105.description: If it please you, I shall continue mine own experiments on white auracite.

106.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_400470_MINFILIA
106.description: Thank you, Urianger. Everyone, pray see to your preparations and depart as soon as you are able. Go well, and be safe.

107.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_500010_MOENBRYDA
107.description: Hold on. I won't be a second.

108.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_500020_MOENBRYDA
108.description: The beast seemed peckish, so I gave it a taste of my axe.

109.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_500030_MOENBRYDA
109.description: I know, I know... As Urianger never tires of reminding me, “An axe ill becometh the hand of a scholar.” What can I say? I like axes. To hear my mother tell it, I came into this world holding one.

110.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_500040_MOENBRYDA
110.description: And it's not as if it stopped me picking up a quill, is it? I often think of the man who introduced me to the joys of learning... He's one of the reasons I decided to come to Eorzea.

111.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_500050_MOENBRYDA
111.description: ...Him and my excruciatingly stiff childhood friend. Considering how unalike we are, it's a wonder we ever got on. The world's a strange old place, isn't it?

112.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_500060_MOENBRYDA
112.description: Aye, that ought to do it.

113.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_500070_MOENBRYDA
113.description: So far, so good. At these concentrations, it shouldn't matter too much if something goes awry. Just enough aether to make it interesting.

114.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_500080_MOENBRYDA
114.description: Did you see that? The way the crystal glowed?

115.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_500090_MOENBRYDA
115.description: The siphon works, I'm happy to say. With a few refinements, it should satisfy our appetite for aether. Which just leaves the small matter of forging our blade.

116.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_500100_MOENBRYDA
116.description: I'm not sure how to go about it just yet, but I swear to find a way. I'll put a blade in your hands if it's the last thing I do.

118.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_500120_MOENBRYDA
118.description: An Ascian!? Are they onto us!?

119.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_500130_NABRIALES
119.description: <hex:024804F2022303>By your brand, I see you are an Archon of Sharlayan. Keeper of knowledge. Seeker of truth. Meddler.<hex:0248020103>

120.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_500140_MOENBRYDA
120.description: I don't know what the hells you're saying, but I don't much like your tone.

121.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_500150_NABRIALES
121.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Hahaha. Your instincts serve you well. But come, be not unsettled on my account. That lovely brow was not made for frowns. Ah, but I waste my breath.<hex:0248020103>

122.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_500160_NABRIALES
122.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Let me direct my words to one who understands them. We meet at last, Warrior of Light. I am Nabriales...<hex:0248020103>

123.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_500170_NABRIALES
123.description: <hex:024804F2022303>...And you have long been a thorn in my side. I suffered the overweening presence of Lahabrea that men might host the power of gods, only for you to undo my hard work.<hex:0248020103>

128.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_500220_NABRIALES
128.description: <hex:024804F2022303>You must concede that I acted in self-defense.<hex:0248020103>

129.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_500230_NABRIALES
129.description: <hex:024804F2022303>But what's this? I do not sense the blessing of Light...<hex:0248020103>

130.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_500240_NABRIALES
130.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Oh dear! Could it be that frail Hydaelyn has forgotten Her champion!? This I did <hex:021A020203>not<hex:021A020103> foresee!<hex:0248020103>

131.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_500250_NABRIALES
131.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Shorn of Light as you are, you are no longer a threat. And better yet, the seal is broken.<hex:0248020103>

132.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_500260_NABRIALES
132.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Now is the time to claim the staff!<hex:0248020103>

133.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_500270_NABRIALES
133.description: <hex:024804F2022303>With it in my grasp, I shall rise above them all and take my place at Lord Zodiark's right hand!<hex:0248020103>

134.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_500280_MOENBRYDA
134.description: What did that bastard want with us?

135.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_500290_MOENBRYDA
135.description: Nabriales, he calls himself? With charm like that, I'll bet he has maidens falling at his feet. Unconscious.

136.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_500300_MOENBRYDA
136.description: But this staff─you say just talking about it had the bastard grinning like a brat on his nameday? Must be quite a staff.

137.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_500310_MOENBRYDA
137.description: Oh, gods... He means Tupsimati, Master Louisoix's staff!

138.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_500320_MOENBRYDA
138.description: Minfilia's in danger! We have to get back to the Rising Stones!

140.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_600020_NABRIALES
140.description: <hex:024804F2022303>So you were able to divine my intent. What now, Warrior of Light? Ah, but that name is no longer fitting. You have become decidedly <hex:021A020203>dull<hex:021A020103>, and quite incapable of barring my entry.<hex:0248020103>

142.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_600040_NABRIALES
142.description: <hex:024804F2022303>You truly do not know? Then I suppose it is only right that I <hex:021A020203>enlighten<hex:021A020103> you.<hex:0248020103>

143.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_600050_NABRIALES
143.description: <hex:024804F2022303>The blessing of Light kept you and your fellow meddlers safe. It was that which prevented my kind from entering your domain.<hex:0248020103>

144.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_600060_NABRIALES
144.description: <hex:024804F2022303>My kind, I say, though it had no power over the likes of Elidibus and Lahabrea. Being of this world, they could come and go as they please, while I could only look on...<hex:0248020103>

145.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_600070_NABRIALES
145.description: <hex:024804F2022303>But I need look no longer. Now that the seal is gone, I mean to act. Unlike the others, I am not given to waiting. I shall take that staff and bring about the next Rejoining.<hex:0248020103>

146.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_600080_MINFILIA
146.description: ...Rejoining? Then it was <hex:021A020203>your<hex:021A020103> doing! The Isle of Val, the scholars─all of it!

150.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_600120_NABRIALES
150.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Why must you insist on forcing my hand? Did you learn nothing from our last meeting? Ah, but I forget─my words fall upon deaf ears.<hex:0248020103>

151.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_600130_MINFILIA
151.description: The staff is but a broken relic─a memorial to the departed. What possible use could you have for it?

152.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_600140_NABRIALES
152.description: <hex:024804F2022303>What use!? You mean to say that all this time, you kept the key, never knowing what it was you possessed?<hex:0248020103>

153.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_600150_NABRIALES
153.description: <hex:024804F2022303>The staff Tupsimati─or rather, the stone tablet it bears─is host to a great power.<hex:0248020103>

154.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_600160_NABRIALES
154.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Together with the horn, it can be used to draw vast quantities of aether from its bearer's surroundings.<hex:0248020103>

155.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_600170_NABRIALES
155.description: <hex:024804F2022303>How else do you think Louisoix was able to invoke the power of the Twelve without making them an offering of crystals?<hex:0248020103>

156.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_600180_NABRIALES
156.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Summoning requires not only prayer, but a profusion of aether. Even a child knows that.<hex:0248020103>

157.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_600190_MINFILIA
157.description: If I did not know before, you may be certain I do now. But above all, I know that we cannot allow this staff to fall into your hands. I will die before I let you take it.

158.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_600200_NABRIALES
158.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Insufferable woman. I would happily end your miserable life here and now... Alas, Elidibus would never let me hear the end of it.<hex:0248020103>

159.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_600210_NABRIALES
159.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Very well. If you will not part with the staff, I will take you too.<hex:0248020103>

160.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_600220_MOENBRYDA
160.description: After them! Quickly...before the rift closes!

161.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_700010_NABRIALES
161.description: It appears I have underestimated you... You are a formidable foe, even without the blessing of Light...

162.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_700020_NABRIALES
162.description: And now I am forced to reveal this unseemly form. Hmph.

164.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_700040_NABRIALES
164.description: <hex:024804F2022303>You may have bested me this day...but what of the next? What of all the days to come!?<hex:0248020103>

165.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_700050_NABRIALES
165.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Remember: Light no longer holds sway here. I may return whensoever I wish. Again and again and again. Eventually, you will falter and the staff will be mine. Until next time, Scions.<hex:0248020103>

166.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_700060_MINFILIA
166.description: There will be no next time! This is the end!

169.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_700090_MINFILIA
169.description: Use Tupsimati to gather aether! Quickly, before he breaks free!

170.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_700100_MINFILIA
170.description: Concentrate! Call to mind the time you struck down Lahabrea with the blade of Light!

171.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_700110_MINFILIA
171.description: Why won't it work? Is it because we lack the blessing of Light?

172.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_700120_MOENBRYDA
172.description: Damn it... So much aether...and it still isn't enough...

173.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_700130_NABRIALES
173.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Fools! No mortal prison can contain me! I shall make you pay for your insolence!<hex:0248020103>

174.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_700140_MINFILIA
174.description: Please, Mother Hydaelyn! Hearken to our plea! Lend us Your divine Light!

175.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_700150_MINFILIA
175.description: Why can You not hear us? Do our words no longer reach You?

176.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_700160_MOENBRYDA
176.description: If only we had...a bit more aether...

178.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_700180_MOENBRYDA
178.description: Master Louisoix... I understand now...the choice you made...

179.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_700190_MOENBRYDA
179.description: In death...there is life... Farewell, Urianger...you daft old coot...

184.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_700240_MINFILIA
184.description: You did it, my friend. The Ascian is dead.

185.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_800010_MINFILIA
185.description: This device is a legacy of Moenbryda's toils and sacrifice.

186.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_800020_MINFILIA
186.description: I shall hold on to it for safekeeping.

189.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_800050_PAPALYMO
189.description: We were surveying northern Thanalan when we received the distress call.

190.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_800060_PAPALYMO
190.description: We returned as swiftly as we were able.

191.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_800070_THANCRED
191.description: It seems you have everything in hand, however.

192.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_800080_YSHTOLA
192.description: What happened here? Where is Moenbryda?

193.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_800090_THANCRED
193.description: She gave her life to temper the blade of Light? I...I have no words.

194.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_800100_YSHTOLA
194.description: Rather than await the inevitable, she took her fate into her own hands.

196.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_800120_MINFILIA
196.description: My friend. There is something I must tell you.

198.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_800140_URIANGER
198.description: The moon sinketh, taking her leave of the heavens. Yet her passing heraldeth the coming of a new day.<hex:02100103>...Moenbryda hath fulfilled her destiny, hath she not?

199.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_800150_URIANGER
199.description: Long ago, far across the seas in the Sharlayan motherland, Moenbryda and I did study under the sage tutelage of Master Louisoix.

200.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_800160_URIANGER
200.description: Full oft did he impress upon us that knowledge existeth to serve the greater good. This sentiment, however, was contrary to the nation's policy of neutrality, which censured intercedence in the affairs of foreign lands.

201.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_800170_URIANGER
201.description: In spite of vehement opposition, he founded the Circle of Knowing and journeyed hither to the heart of Eorzea. Through his noble sacrifice was the realm spared its doom.

202.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_800180_URIANGER
202.description: Yet this great soul, whom all should rightly have honored, was branded a pariah in his own land. His peers did accuse him of forsaking his duty as a man of learning, and of meddling in the course of history.

203.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_800190_URIANGER
203.description: When he left Sharlayan behind, Master Louisoix gave no word to signal his intent to Moenbryda. Close as they were, as master and disciple, she was deeply wounded by the sudden exclusion from his confidence.

204.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_800200_URIANGER
204.description: Above all, however, she was confused. Try as she might, she could ill comprehend her master's motive. The slanders that were heaped upon him after his passing served only to inflame the turmoil within her.

205.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_800210_URIANGER
205.description: For years upon end, she knew not what to believe, torn as she was 'twixt the man whom she revered, and the man who forsook her and his duty both.

206.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_800220_MINFILIA
206.description: The Louisoix I knew would never forsake his duty, much less one of his own.

207.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_800230_URIANGER
207.description: This I know full well, my lady. 'Twas not for want of love that Master Louisoix hid his intent. He but desired that Moenbryda discover her own path, free of the shadow of his influence.

208.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_800240_URIANGER
208.description: Long did I contemplate revealing the truth to her, and long did I hold my peace. After all, was it not Master Louisoix's wish that she come to the truth unaided? I told myself it was, and resolved to let her suffer.

209.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_800250_URIANGER
209.description: Knowingly did I deny my friend the comfort she craved. And now she hath gone to her rest with doubt still in her heart.

210.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_800260_URIANGER
210.description: Speakest thou in earnest? Did Moenbryda truly come to understand Master Louisoix's will before the end?

211.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_800270_URIANGER
211.description: The realization hath set her free. She may now find the peace which hath for so long eluded her.

212.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_800280_URIANGER
212.description: Oh, Moenbryda... My dearest... How I shall miss thee...

213.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_800290_MINFILIA
213.description: Moenbryda gave her life that we might possess the means to defeat the Ascians.

214.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_800300_MINFILIA
214.description: Her sacrifice must not be in vain. Let us continue her work on the blade of aether and see it to completion.

215.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_800310_URIANGER
215.description: My lady. I would mourn Moenbryda in mine own way. I beg your permission to return to the Waking Sands.

216.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_800320_MINFILIA
216.description: Of course, my friend. Take all the time you require. We shall be here should you have need of us.

217.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_900010_MINFILIA
217.description: Forgive me, Moenbryda. Had I been quicker, or wiser...

218.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_900020_MINFILIA
218.description: But I was not, and you paid the price.

219.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_900030_MINFILIA
219.description: But you would not suffer us to wallow in our sorrow, would you? You would tell us to...pick ourselves up and get on with it.

220.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_900040_MINFILIA
220.description: And so we shall. We shall defend this realm and her people to the last.

221.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_900060_MIDGARDSORMR
221.description: Life for death. A fair exchange.

223.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_900050_YDA
223.description: I'll never forget you, Moen. None of us will.

224.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_900080_MIDGARDSORMR
224.description: The song riseth to a crescendo.

225.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_900090_YDA
225.description: Is that what I think it is...?

227.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_900110_ALPHINAUD
227.description: We have received grave tidings from Ishgard. Pray return to the Rising Stones at once.

228.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_900120_MINFILIA
228.description: Twelve forfend, is the hour already upon us!?

229.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_900130_MINFILIA
229.description: Come. Our enemies do not rest, and neither will we.

230.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_A00010_ICEHEART
230.description: (-Iceheart-)The sons must answer for their fathers' misdeeds. Only then will the cycle be broken...

231.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_A00020_ICEHEART
231.description: (-Iceheart-)Brothers and sisters of the heavens! We raise our voices and join you in the chorus!

232.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_A00030_ICEHEART
232.description: (-Iceheart-)The sinners' feeble magicks are undone! Come! Claim your retribution!

234.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_C00010_MINFILIA
234.description: Alphinaud, it is good to see you. Tell me, what have you learned?

235.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_C00020_ALPHINAUD
235.description: Pray summon the others. Everyone must hear my report.

236.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_C00030_MINFILIA
236.description: So this was all but a taste of what's to come...

237.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_C00040_ALPHINAUD
237.description: Indeed. The main host advances upon Ishgard as we speak.

238.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_C00050_PAPALYMO
238.description: Whose vaunted defenses have been nullified.

239.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_C00060_YSHTOLA
239.description: Shorn of its wards, the city will bear the full force of Nidhogg's fury.

241.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_C00080_THANCRED
241.description: Alphinaud is right. The Dravanians cannot be allowed to prevail. If Ishgard falls, all of Eorzea will suffer the consequences.

242.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_C00090_ALPHINAUD
242.description: Then you agree that we have no choice but to intervene. For the good of the realm, the Scions of the Seventh Dawn and the Crystal Braves must join the defense of Ishgard.

243.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_C00100_MINFILIA
243.description: Let there be no ambiguity about what has been proposed. We would be directly intervening in the war.

244.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_C00110_MINFILIA
244.description: But if all here believe the cause to be just, then to war we shall go.

245.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_C00120_MINFILIA
245.description: The path we now embark upon is perilous, but I pray you will walk with us to the end.

246.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_C00130_MINFILIA
246.description: For those we have lost. For those we can yet save.

247.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_C00140_ALPHINAUD
247.description: Then it is settled. I shall inform the council of our intentions, and request that they contribute their own forces to the defense of Ishgard.

248.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_D00010_MERLWYB
248.description: We are well aware of Ishgard's dilemma, and we agree with your assessment.

249.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_D00020_ALPHINAUD
249.description: Then I trust there are no objections to the Crystal Braves' intervention?

252.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_D00050_MERLWYB
252.description: The Crystal Braves are yours to command, Alphinaud. Do what you will. We shall pray for your success.

253.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_D00060_ALPHINAUD
253.description: It was my hope that you would offer more substantial aid than prayer. I know it is within your means.

254.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_D00070_MERLWYB
254.description: Do not presume that you have knowledge of our every concern. The Garleans and the beast tribes are but two of many.

255.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_D00080_MERLWYB
255.description: We are not in a position to contribute greatly to the defense of Ishgard─not when our own homes are still under siege.

256.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_D00090_KANESENNA
256.description: We dare not leave our interests in Carteneau undefended as well. Teledji Adeledji and his ilk would seize control of the territories in our absence.

257.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_D00100_ALPHINAUD
257.description: The enemy is at their gates, and you would cower behind yours!?

258.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_D00110_RAUBAHN
258.description: No one is cowering, boy. We will offer what support we can.

259.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_D00120_MERLWYB
259.description: Aye. <hex:021A020203>Support<hex:021A020103>. A handful of men and no more.

260.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_D00130_KANESENNA
260.description: Would that we could commit more than a token force to this cause. Yet there <hex:021A020203>are<hex:021A020103> others to whom you might turn. The free companies ever want for work.

261.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_D00140_RAUBAHN
261.description: Ah, yes, the free companies... They're not like to turn you down.

262.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_D00150_ALPHINAUD
262.description: I beg your pardon!? You would entrust the survival of Ishgard to <hex:021A020203>sellswords<hex:021A020103>!?

263.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_D00160_ALPHINAUD
263.description: Crises like these are the very reason why this alliance was formed! It is our duty to aid our fellow man!

264.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_D00170_MERLWYB
264.description: My <hex:021A020203>duty<hex:021A020103> is to <hex:021A020203>my<hex:021A020103> country and <hex:021A020203>my<hex:021A020103> people.

265.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_D00180_MERLWYB
265.description: If you expect us to place the welfare of a foreign power above our own, you're going to be sorely disappointed.

266.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_D00190_MERLWYB
266.description: Lest you doubt, Limsa comes first, then the Alliance, and finally─circumstances permitting─Ishgard and the rest.

267.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_D00200_MERLWYB
267.description: If you cannot understand so simple a concept, then you have no place at this table.

268.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_D00210_ALPHINAUD
268.description: Forgive me, Admiral. I was...careless in my choice of words.

269.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_D00220_RAUBAHN
269.description: I suggest you assemble a party of elite adventurers, assuming you haven't already. Your fellows served us well during Operation Archon. I daresay they will do so again.

270.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_D00230_RAUBAHN
270.description: If I may, Your Grace, I wish to propose a redistribution of forces.

271.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_D00240_RAUBAHN
271.description: If we entrust the security of Ul'dah to the Brass Blades for a time, we can dispatch a larger force to Ishgard.

273.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_D00260_NANAMOULNAMO
273.description: Yes, yes of course. Do what you will.

274.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_D00270_RAUBAHN
274.description: Is Her Grace not feeling well?

275.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_D00280_LADYINWAITING2
275.description: To the best of my knowledge, Her Grace is in perfect health.

277.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_F00010_NANAMOULNAMO
277.description: O Sultantree, hallowed spirit of my line...

278.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_F00020_NANAMOULNAMO
278.description: Through my weakness, the glorious House of Ul has all but disappeared beneath the sands. For want of the strength to raise it up again, it were better that it fall.

279.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_F00030_NANAMOULNAMO
279.description: Forgive me, but I know not what else to do...

281.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_G00020_LADYINWAITING2
281.description: Your Grace is most kind, but it is no trouble to me, rather an honor.

282.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_G00030_LADYINWAITING2
282.description: If Your Grace is ready, I shall summon the Warrior of Light.

284.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_H00010_KANESENNA
284.description: I take it you have grown accustomed to your responsibilities?

285.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_H00020_AYMERIC
285.description: The day-to-day duties are not so demanding. The social obligations, on the other hand...

286.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_H00030_MINFILIA
286.description: Everyone looks to be in high spirits.

288.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_H00050_MINFILIA
288.description: A common victory may serve to unite even the most unlikely of allies.

289.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_H00060_MINFILIA
289.description: You've brought us one step closer to a united Eorzea.

290.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_H00070_ALPHINAUD
290.description: Your modesty knows no bounds, Antecedent.

291.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_H00080_ALPHINAUD
291.description: Were it not for your efforts, Ser Aymeric would never have become such a steadfast ally.

292.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_H00090_ALPHINAUD
292.description: When he convinces his countrymen to rejoin the Alliance, we shall all reap the benefits─military <hex:021A020203>and<hex:021A020103> economic.

293.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_H00100_ALPHINAUD
293.description: I tell you, we are on the cusp of a new era of unity and prosperity.

294.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_H00110_ALPHINAUD
294.description: Territorial disputes are all that divide us now.

295.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_H00120_ALPHINAUD
295.description: But I have faith that we will find an amicable solution in time.

296.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_H00130_ALPHINAUD
296.description: And failing that, I'll have my trusty Warrior of Light box the ears of all concerned. Speaking of whom...?

297.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_H00140_MINFILIA
297.description: <hex:02080CE905FF04536865FF03486503> will be joining us shortly. A matter at the Quicksand required <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> attention, but it did not sound serious.

299.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_I00020_LADYINWAITING2
299.description: Your Grace. Your guest has arrived.

300.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_I00030_NANAMOULNAMO
300.description: Pray come in, and take your ease.

301.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_J00010_MERLWYB
301.description: 'Tis well that the Steps of Faith held against the Horde.

302.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_J00020_KANESENNA
302.description: And what of the city proper?

303.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_J00030_AYMERIC
303.description: We sustained some few losses, but the heart of our nation yet beats with vigor. I am not certain I could say the same had we not received your most generous aid.

304.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_J00040_RAUBAHN
304.description: An attack on Ishgard is an attack on the realm. We stand together or fall divided.

306.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_J00060_AYMERIC
306.description: I had hoped to speak in the presence of Her Grace, but it seems she has been delayed... That being the case, now would seem as good a time as any...

307.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_J00070_AYMERIC
307.description: Honored friends! Pray allow me to convey Ishgard's warmest gratitude for your part in the defense of our lands.

308.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_J00080_AYMERIC
308.description: 'Tis upon the success of this very alliance that my recommendation to throw open the Gates of Judgement shall be founded. With the blessing of the archbishop, it is my hope that Ishgard will soon be reunited with her long-estranged sister nations─and that Eorzea shall once more be as one!

311.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_J00110_ALPHINAUD
311.description: Nothing to worry about. I shall return anon.

315.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_K00030_NANAMOULNAMO
315.description: You must be curious as to the reason for this private audience. The matter I would discuss, however, will soon make apparent the need for discretion.

316.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_K00040_NANAMOULNAMO
316.description: I intend to abdicate the throne and dissolve the monarchy.

317.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_K00050_NANAMOULNAMO
317.description: You have seen for yourself the storm of turmoil that howls through our streets. The government fails in its responsibilities, and my subjects suffer the consequences of our incompetence.

318.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_K00060_NANAMOULNAMO
318.description: But I will see them suffer no longer. The victory feast shall provide the stage on which I declare the dissolution of the sultanate.

319.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_K00070_NANAMOULNAMO
319.description: 'Tis mine intent that the ruling class of our golden city should take its place beside the common man in a fair and equitable republic. No more shall this nation bow to the whims of a privileged few.

320.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_K00080_NANAMOULNAMO
320.description: Yet that which I propose will entail the tearing up of this city's very foundations. And even Raubahn with all his strength and influence will be hard-pressed to keep his footing on such treacherous ground.

321.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_K00090_NANAMOULNAMO
321.description: Thus would I ask you to lend him a steadying hand.

322.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_K00100_NANAMOULNAMO
322.description: You who have endured the wrath of innumerable foes are the one hero in whom I can place my trust. Will you do this thing for me?

323.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_K00110_NANAMOULNAMO
323.description: I am truly grateful. More grateful than I can well express.

324.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_K00120_NANAMOULNAMO
324.description: How much we have both changed since that day we met beneath the Sultantree... And the days ahead promise to change us further still. I hope that we will recognize ourselves when all of this is over...

325.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_K00130_NANAMOULNAMO
325.description: Much of my dread for the coming days has been quieted...

327.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_K00150_TELEDJIADELEDJI
327.description: Her Grace... The sultana is dead.

330.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_K00180_TELEDJIADELEDJI
330.description: Spare us your denials! I see no other suspects, and the room has but the one entrance!

331.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_K00190_TELEDJIADELEDJI
331.description: I hereby accuse you of regicide! Men─arrest this viper!

334.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_L00020_CRYSTALBRAVE02400
334.description: (-Crystal Brave-)Sir. Barring a few exceptions, we have detained all those with allegiance to the Scions. The Rising Stones is also under our control.

335.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_L00030_ALPHINAUD
335.description: And what do you hope to achieve with this mutiny?

336.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_L00040_YUYUHASE
336.description: Why, that which we have striven for all along, Commander: the salvation of Eorzea.

337.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_M00010_RAUBAHN
337.description: What is the meaning of this?

338.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_M00020_AYMERIC
338.description: Knights from the homeland? This cannot bode well...

339.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_M00030_TELEDJIADELEDJI
339.description: Lord Commander. We have received an urgent message from the Holy See.

340.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_M00040_TELEDJIADELEDJI
340.description: I am grieved to report that your serpentine foes have resumed their assault. Needless to say, your presence is urgently required. These knights have come to bear you swiftly home to Ishgard.

342.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_M00060_LUCIA
342.description: We've had no such word from our men. And the timing is most fortuitous to catch us away from the city...

345.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_M00090_AYMERIC
345.description: You have been a most gracious host. I hope that I might one day return the favor.

347.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_N00010_THANCRED
347.description: Whatever is going on in there...?

348.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_N00020_THANCRED
348.description: Ah, the ever-dutiful Brass Blades. I must apologize, but my dance card is rather full. Another time, perhaps?

349.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_N00030_BRASSBLADE02400
349.description: Thancred of the Scions of the Seventh Dawn. You stand accused of committing acts of espionage in service to the Garlean Empire.

350.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_N00040_THANCRED
350.description: Espionage? What in the seven hells are you talking about?

351.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_N00050_THANCRED
351.description: Ah. If you're referring to that business with the Ultima Weapon, then you must understand─I-I wasn't myself...

352.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_N00060_BRASSBLADE02400
352.description: Under interrogation, an imperial prisoner revealed your involvement in numerous dealings with the enemy. We've also been investigating reports that you are a practitioner of forbidden arts.

353.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_N00070_BRASSBLADE02400
353.description: You'd best come along with us.

354.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_N00080_THANCRED
354.description: You invite me to your party and now you want me to leave? I do so detest receiving mixed signals.

355.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_N00090_THANCRED
355.description: Come, then. I believe I've lost my appetite for this farce of a celebration!

356.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_O00010_RAUBAHN
356.description: You go too far, Lord Adeledji! By what right do you march armed soldiers into a royal banquet and eject state visitors without Her Grace's consent!?

357.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_O00020_RAUBAHN
357.description: You treat the Brass Blades as your personal army, and show contempt for the throne with your every act. Leave us. Now.

358.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_O00030_TELEDJIADELEDJI
358.description: Is that an order, General? Mayhap you have mistaken me for one of your Flames? You will find I am not so slavishly obedient. And you lecture <hex:021A020203>me<hex:021A020103> on personal armies!

359.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_O00040_TELEDJIADELEDJI
359.description: As for your <hex:021A020203>outrageous<hex:021A020103> claim that I have shown contempt for the throne, let all here observe that it was not <hex:021A020203>I<hex:021A020103> who feasted while an assassin removed its occupant!

360.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_O00050_TELEDJIADELEDJI
360.description: I expect this is your idea of defending the nation, is it? This and diluting our forces through these distractions in Carteneau and Coerthas!

361.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_O00060_TELEDJIADELEDJI
361.description: I do begin to see how the ranks of the Immortal Flames came to be riddled with Garlean sympathizers! You are plainly unfit for command!

362.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_O00070_RAUBAHN
362.description: Wait... Wait, gods damn you! Your words make no sense. What assassin?

363.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_O00080_TELEDJIADELEDJI
363.description: You mean to say you don't know!? We caught the vaunted champion of the Scions in Her Grace's private chambers not moments after the deed was done!

365.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_O00100_TELEDJIADELEDJI
365.description: Save your breath. You will need it to plead your case. You and your entire order are to be tried for this atrocity.

367.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_P00010_ILBERD
367.description: This <hex:02080FE905FF06776F6D616EFF046D616E03> stands accused of poisoning Her Royal Majesty Nanamo Ul Namo. And as suspected accessories to the crime, all members of the Scions of the Seventh Dawn will be detained for questioning!

369.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_P00030_ILBERD
369.description: What a pity... Who'd have thought your tale would end like this?

370.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_P00040_TELEDJIADELEDJI
370.description: Should you demand further proof, a vial with traces of the substance used to poison Her Grace was found upon the assassin's person.

373.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_P00070_TELEDJIADELEDJI
373.description: Who persuaded Her Grace to host this celebration? A diversion which presented you and your confederates ample opportunity to commit the crime, and a crowd within which to fade from view! A more “convenient” occasion I could scarcely imagine!

374.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_P00080_MINFILIA
374.description: How dare you! After all we have done for Ul'dah!

375.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_P00090_TELEDJIADELEDJI
375.description: Hold your tongue, witch! I'll not be ensorcelled! I know all about the dark gift that you and your disciples wield!

376.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_P00100_TELEDJIADELEDJI
376.description: Oh, yes...I've observed how you worked upon the minds of the Alliance leaders, bending them to your will!

377.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_P00110_TELEDJIADELEDJI
377.description: And what of your <hex:021A020203>cordial<hex:021A020103> relationship with Ser Aymeric? For years, Ishgard abjured all contact with the outside world, and now the lord commander of the Temple Knights treats you with the familiarity of a childhood friend!

378.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_P00120_TELEDJIADELEDJI
378.description: I'll tell you what I think─I think this desperate defense of Ishgard was but a ruse to deceive us into dividing our forces.

379.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_P00130_TELEDJIADELEDJI
379.description: Your next move will be to charm your Coerthan allies into invading our lands!

381.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_P00150_YDA
381.description: How do you even think of this stuff!?

383.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_P00170_RAUBAHN
383.description: Stand aside, Ilberd! I want to see the sultana!

384.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_P00180_ILBERD
384.description: Spare yourself the pain, brother. I saw her with my own eyes.

385.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_P00190_ILBERD
385.description: For a mercy, the poison took her swiftly─her handmaiden can attest to that.

388.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_Q00010_TELEDJIADELEDJI
388.description: Plainly, the Royalists can no longer be relied upon to keep our nation safe. And so it falls to the Monetarists of the Syndicate to govern Ul'dah. But should you wish to help us, General, we would be more than happy to entrust the task of planning Her Grace's funeral to you.

389.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_Q00020_TELEDJIADELEDJI
389.description: It seems only right that you should bury your precious sultana, and we will be glad to be rid of that burden.

390.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_Q00030_RAUBAHN
390.description: I'll bet you will. You more than any man.

392.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_Q00050_RAUBAHN
392.description: I mean you had her killed, you black-hearted bastard!

393.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_Q00060_TELEDJIADELEDJI
393.description: What rot! ...Though I did have sufficient motive, 'tis true. That young lady caused me no end of grief.

394.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_Q00070_TELEDJIADELEDJI
394.description: She always was a most unwilling puppet. I daresay Her Grace was grateful that someone thought to cut her strings.

395.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_Q00080_RAUBAHN
395.description: You would mock her? THEN MOCK HER FROM HELL!

397.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_Q00100_LOLORITO
397.description: Have you lost your mind, General!? It is forbidden to draw steel in the royal chambers, much less slaughter our fellow Syndicate members!

398.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_Q00110_LOLORITO
398.description: <gasp> ...You're one of them! You've been in league with the Scions all along!

399.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_Q00120_RAUBAHN
399.description: YOU! You're next, you scheming bastard!

405.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_Q00180_ILBERD
405.description: How unlike you, old friend. I did not expect to take your arm so easily.

406.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_Q00230_LOLORITO
406.description: Take the Scions into custody! They have conspired to commit regicide!

407.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_Q00240_LOLORITO
407.description: And arrest this traitor as well!

408.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_Q00190_RAUBAHN
408.description: Ilberd! I hope you choke on their coin!

409.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_Q00200_ILBERD
409.description: 'Tis better than the dirt I've supped on these long years. We can't all abandon Ala Mhigo and become great war heroes as you have.

410.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_Q00210_ILBERD
410.description: You are not the man you once were, Raubahn. Since that girl strapped the yoke around your neck, you've become docile.

411.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_Q00220_ILBERD
411.description: She took the mad bull and cut off his balls. And a bull that cannot rut is fit for naught but slaughter.

412.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_Q00250_ILBERD
412.description: Shall I tell you who really killed your precious sultana?

416.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_Q00280_RAUBAHN
416.description: I never doubted you. Not for a moment. But there is more to this than I yet understand.

417.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_Q00290_RAUBAHN
417.description: Flee this place. Clear your names.

418.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_Q00300_RAUBAHN
418.description: Find out who is behind this plot! It is the only way! Now go!

422.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_Q00340_THANCRED
422.description: Avoiding the fumbling advances of some very persistent admirers.

423.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_Q00341_THANCRED
423.description: When I realized the celebrations had turned sour, it seemed prudent to slip away and take stock of the situation.

424.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_Q00350_THANCRED
424.description: 'Twould appear that much of the city is already under tight guard. It occurs to me that expanding the Brass Blades' authority may not have been such a wonderful idea after all...

425.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_Q00360_PAPALYMO
425.description: The success of this plan was contingent upon those thugs having the run of the place. Just how long has this scheme been in motion?

426.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_Q00370_YSHTOLA
426.description: The careful preparations, the maneuvering of forces... I am inclined to agree with the General's insistence that a deeper plot exists here.

427.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_Q00380_YDA
427.description: So...would I be right in thinking we now have an excuse to pummel as many Brass Blades as we like?

428.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_Q00390_PAPALYMO
428.description: Unless you plan on pummeling them <hex:021A020203>all<hex:021A020103>, I'm not sure that will greatly aid our cause.

429.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_Q00400_MINFILIA
429.description: The sultana's assassination was but one part of the scheme. We too were its targets. And though we did not share poor Nanamo's fate, we are yet hobbled by the charges laid at our door. Where now might we seek refuge?

430.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_Q00410_PAPALYMO
430.description: Where indeed. We may safely assume that our foe has thought to have the Rising Stones watched.

431.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_Q00420_THANCRED
431.description: Forgive me for stating the obvious, but our choice of destination will matter little if we cannot secure an escape route out of Ul'dah.

432.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_Q00430_THANCRED
432.description: Happily, I believe I can provide one. Papashan once told me about the passages hidden in the walls of the palace. If I recall correctly, the fireplace in Nanamo's chambers conceals the entrance to a tunnel.

433.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_Q00440_THANCRED
433.description: It should lead outside the city, and allow us to avoid any messy confrontations.

434.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_Q00450_YDA
434.description: The rest of you go on ahead. I'll handle this lot!

436.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_Q00461_PAPALYMO
436.description: <sigh> ...I suppose I shall just have to join you.

437.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_Q00480_YDA
437.description: Crystal Braves, too, huh? Now <hex:021A020203>this<hex:021A020103> should be interesting!

439.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_Q00490_PAPALYMO
439.description: We will hold our pursuers here. Hurry, now! Find this tunnel of Thancred's!

441.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_R00010_YDA
441.description: Ow! Now look what you've done!

442.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_R00020_PAPALYMO
442.description: Yda, are you all right!? There are just too many of them...

443.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_R00030_YDA
443.description: I'm fine! I could do this all day! How about you?

445.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_R00050_YDA
445.description: This is so <hex:021A020203>stupid<hex:021A020103>! We're the Scions of the Seventh Dawn! The ones who stand between this realm and the evil that's trying to destroy it!

446.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_R00060_PAPALYMO
446.description: And if you think we'll leave the stewardship of Eorzea to the likes of your masters, then you're sorely mistaken!

447.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_R00070_YDA
447.description: Sorry I dragged you into this, Papalymo...

448.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_R00080_PAPALYMO
448.description: Hah, 'tis hardly the first time. And I'll be damned if it will be the last.

450.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_R00100_YDA
450.description: I was hoping you'd say that!

451.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_S00010_MINFILIA
451.description: I never knew such a watercourse existed beneath Ul'dah.

452.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_S00020_YSHTOLA
452.description: The architecture is of the Sil'dihn style, if I am not mistaken. The ancients plainly foresaw the need for a ready means of escape.

454.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_S00040_THANCRED
454.description: Well, that didn't take long. It seems these tunnels were not as secret as I had hoped.

455.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_S00050_YSHTOLA
455.description: You two go on ahead. Thancred and I will deal with this.

456.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_S00060_MINFILIA
456.description: Wh-What do you mean to do!?

457.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_S00070_YSHTOLA
457.description: Only that which is required to ensure that the dawn's light survive to brighten the morrow.

458.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_S00080_THANCRED
458.description: Fear not, Antecedent. You haven't seen the last of these fair features.

461.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_S00110_THANCRED
461.description: What is the plan, milady? Shall I take the dozen on the left, and you the dozen on the right? The odds are not exactly stacked in our favor...

462.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_S00120_YSHTOLA
462.description: Numbers will count for little when I bring the tunnel down upon their heads. Though I cannot say I relish the thought of being entombed with you for all eternity.

463.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_S00130_THANCRED
463.description: You wound me! I will have you know that many a maid would <hex:021A020203>kill<hex:021A020103> for the chance to spend forever at my side! Now, may I have the last dance?

465.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_S00150_THANCRED
465.description: Well, this is going splendidly... Now would be a good time, milady!

471.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_T00030_MINFILIA
471.description: I must remain behind...but you cannot stay with me.

472.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_T00040_MINFILIA
472.description: Please, you must go on! You are the Warrior of Light! You are <hex:021A020203>hope<hex:021A020103>─for the Scions, and for all the realm!

473.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_T00050_MINFILIA
473.description: As long as your flame continues to burn, the light of the dawn may ever be relit!

474.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_T00060_MINFILIA
474.description: You must escape, and save Eorzea from those who would plunge it into darkness!

476.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_U00010_ALPHINAUD
476.description: I am glad to see you safe, my friend! What of the others?

478.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_U00030_ALPHINAUD
478.description: Teledji played me for a fool! I thought the Crystal Braves mine till the very moment I felt the blade at my back...

479.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_U00040_PIPPIN
479.description: (-???-)There will be ample time for soul-searching later. For now, we must put some malms between us and Ul'dah.

480.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_U00050_BREMONDT
480.description: Well, if it ain't the hero of the Scions! You look to me like a <hex:02080FE905FF06776F6D616EFF046D616E03> in need of a nice, relaxin' carriage ride!

481.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_U00060_BREMONDT
481.description: Well, would you look who it is! Need a ride? I doubt it'll be half as excitin' as the last trip we took─not if I have anythin' to say about it, anyway!

482.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_U00070_BREMONDT
482.description: Let's not dawdle, eh? All aboard!

483.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_V00010_BREMONDT
483.description: I was stockin' up on supplies over in Vesper Bay, you see, when your sister come up an' begged a favor. Said her brother was havin' some trouble down in Ul'dah, an' likely needed a helpin' hand gettin' away.

484.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_V00020_BREMONDT
484.description: Thinkin' them ruins would make a fine hidin' place, I decided to try there first...an' lo an' behold, there you were.

485.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_V00030_BREMONDT
485.description: Aye, an' judgin' by them soldiers as were pourin' out of the city, I arrived not a moment too soon...

486.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_V00040_BREMONDT
486.description: Must've been fate that we happened to find <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103> there though, eh?

487.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_V00050_ALPHINAUD
487.description: I had thought to look out for Alisaie, but 'twould appear she was the one watching over me. I've made such a mess of things...

488.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_V00060_BREMONDT
488.description: An' who might you be, young sir?

489.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_V00070_PIPPIN
489.description: Pipin Tarupin, Vice Marshal of the Immortal Flames.

490.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_V00080_PIPPIN
490.description: I had been on the Ala Mhigan front these past few moons, but an urgent communication called me back to Ul'dah.

491.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_V00090_PIPPIN
491.description: Scarce had my boots touched the cobbles, though, when the streets erupted with cries of assassination. I immediately went in search of answers, and came across Master Alphinaud here. Needless to say, I did not think his imprisonment justified.

492.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_V00100_PIPPIN
492.description: The blame plainly lies with the Monetarists. Their greed and corruption are well known to me, but for them to take advantage of the situation with such alacrity...

493.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_V00110_BREMONDT
493.description: ...Was that “Pipin,” you said? Ain't that the name of General Aldynn's lad?

494.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_V00120_PIPPIN
494.description: Yes, I am his son. Adopted, of course. 'Twas only as we were leaving Ul'dah that I learned of Father's fate.

495.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_V00130_PIPPIN
495.description: Once I have seen you a safe distance away, I mean to return to the city and extricate him from this madness.

496.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_V00140_BREMONDT
496.description: Then you needn't travel no further than Black Brush─our fugitives have a friend waitin' for 'em there.

497.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_V00150_ALPHINAUD
497.description: I dreamed of bringing about Eorzea's salvation, but in the end...

499.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_W00010_HAURCHEFANT
499.description: There has been word from the capital. Ishgard has weathered another assault, and 'tis said several wyverns broke through into the city proper.

500.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_W00020_HAURCHEFANT
500.description: The Temple Knights succeeded in slaying the beasts, but the intrusion prompted orders to further strengthen the guard and to place the city under a perpetual state of alert.

501.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_W00030_HAURCHEFANT
501.description: How keenly we feel the loss of our wards at the Gates of Judgement...

502.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_W00040_HAURCHEFANT
502.description: Yet we must not bemoan our misfortune. Ser Aymeric is safely returned from Ul'dah and once more leads the defense of Ishgard.

503.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_W00050_HAURCHEFANT
503.description: As for the matter of your asylum, I am afraid no progress will be made until the threat to our nation has diminished.

504.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_W00060_HAURCHEFANT
504.description: But do not despair! You are not without allies.

505.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_W00070_HAURCHEFANT
505.description: You are more than welcome to shelter here for as long as you wish. Pray think of it as a new headquarters of sorts─the “Falling Snows” or some such!

506.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_W00080_HAURCHEFANT
506.description: All frivolity aside, any who come here in search of you will receive no aid from House Fortemps. For once, the Ishgardian reputation for inhospitality shall work in our favor.

507.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_W00090_HAURCHEFANT
507.description: Agents of Ul'dah will find their every inquiry dismissed, and their every request for entry rebuffed, until such time as their masters have acknowledged your innocence.

508.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_W00100_HAURCHEFANT
508.description: You once fought to preserve the honor of my dear friend─'tis a blessing that I may now repay that debt in kind.

509.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_W00110_HAURCHEFANT
509.description: But let us dwell no more on this. Pray join the rest of your companions.

510.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_W00120_HAURCHEFANT
510.description: 'Tis bitterly cold this day. I suspect there are those who might welcome the warmth your presence brings.

512.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_X00020_ALPHINAUD
512.description: I believed myself the only one who truly understood Eorzea's woes. And look what that arrogance has wrought.

513.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_X00030_ALPHINAUD
513.description: I gave commands, influenced governments with my certainty...

514.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_X00040_ALPHINAUD
514.description: I treated the Crystal Braves, and even the Scions themselves, as pawns in my great scheme to save the realm.

515.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_X00050_ALPHINAUD
515.description: But in my headlong rush unto imagined glory, I paid no heed to the ground upon which I trod!

516.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_X00060_ALPHINAUD
516.description: The salvation of Eorzea... What was it that I hoped to achieve?

517.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_X00070_ALPHINAUD
517.description: Did I believe that I could rid the realm of every danger and difficulty? That I could defeat the Empire and the Ascians, and find homes for every refugee?

518.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_X00080_ALPHINAUD
518.description: Oh yes, I was so very clever. “Become a guardian of Eorzea,” I implored, and sat back to watch my perfect army cleanse the land of chaos.

519.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_X00090_ALPHINAUD
519.description: 'Twas all but a means to feed my own vanity.

520.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_X00100_ALPHINAUD
520.description: Only when all is lost do I finally realize the truth.

522.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_X00120_HAURCHEFANT
522.description: So, Master Alphinaud, are you content to remain a broken blade? Is there no flame hot enough to reforge you?

523.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_X00130_HAURCHEFANT
523.description: What of the fine companions who yet stand at your side? I daresay the fires of their determination will soon have you slicing the air again with your customary wit!

524.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_X00140_ALPHINAUD
524.description: I hardly deserve such friendship. And besides, where are we to go...?

526.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_X00160_TATARU
526.description: Should this place not serve our purpose, then...then we shall go to Ishgard!

527.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_X00170_TATARU
527.description: Minfilia told me many times: as long as we stand fast against despair, the beacon of hope will never be lost to sight.

528.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_X00180_TATARU
528.description: Be it in the snow or in the clouds, we few will see that the dawn's light shines again!

530.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_X00200_ALPHINAUD
530.description: You are right, Tataru, thank you. And thank you for your kind words, Lord Haurchefant.

531.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_X00210_ALPHINAUD
531.description: 'Tis true that Eorzea yet has her guardians.

532.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_X00220_ALPHINAUD
532.description: The Scions have achieved much, and 'twould be remiss of me to discard it all in a fit of self-pity.

533.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_X00230_ALPHINAUD
533.description: Let us then resume our journey, together...one step at a time.

534.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_Y00010_LADYINWAITING2
534.description: All has been arranged as you desired, my lord.

536.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_Z00010_MIDGARDSORMR
536.description: Heh heh heh. Thou thinkest sanctuary lieth beyond?

537.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02500_Z00020_MIDGARDSORMR
537.description: Delusion. Despair. Death. Thou shalt find naught else here.
